content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-423. - I.P.C. Section 710.1, Maximum fixture unit load.
content.summary:
Section 710.1. Maximum fixture unit load,
is hereby amended by adding a second paragraph to read as follows:
"
710.1. Maximum fixture unit load.
The building drain shall be four inches (101.6 mm) to the first three inch (76.2
